title: 第7章 天灵根通不过正式考核第8章 苏白出手秒杀炼气九重
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
“你一夜未归，你就不考虑考虑你家人的感受？”
苏白板着脸训斥道。
“我......”萧灵汐低着头，嘟囔道：“他们难道就考虑过我的感受吗？”
“你呀你呀！”苏白无奈。
萧灵汐不是他的孩子，他无权干涉过多。
要是自家孩子如此调皮，他保证掏出七匹狼给孩子一个完美的童年！
“叮，宿主修为已突破！”
突然，苏白脑海中响起系统的声音。
【宿主】
姓名：苏白
年龄：18
境界：炼气三重
物品：20文钱
“炼气三重？”
苏白的目光，不由得看向一旁还在修炼的诸葛风。
他作为天道宗的宗主，其修为是宗门所有的弟子修为之和的十倍。
而如今，天道宗，就只有诸葛风一个弟子！
他的修为，相当于与诸葛风绑定在了一起。
也就是说，他突破了，那.........
“叮，弟子修为突破，奖励10点宗门积分。”

“砰！”
一声脆响自诸葛风体内响起，紧接着，他周围的气流猛然暴涨了数倍，一股强大的气势爆发而出。
唰——
他睁开双眼，目中精光四射，神采奕奕。
炼气一重！
“呼......”诸葛风吐出一口浊气，缓缓握拳，一阵噼啪声传出，一层淡淡青芒浮现在拳头之上。
“这就是那些仙人所拥有的力量吗？”
他平时也会抽出时间锻炼身体，加上当杂役的工作经常是重活累活，双手可举起几百斤的重物。
可此刻，当灵气冲破了穴窍之后，全身都被灵气所增强，充满着无尽力量。
这一刻，诸葛风只觉浑身有使不完的劲儿。
“我现在的力量，应该可以为父母报仇了吧？”诸葛风攥紧了拳头，眸中泛着血色。
“一晚上炼气一重？”
萧灵汐傻眼了，从她认识苏白至今，短短一日，她已经不知道震惊了多少次了。
就算天道宗的仙法逆天的强大，也不至于一夜炼气吧？
要知道，灵霄宗的第一天才凌霄，昔日半个月炼气一重，都已经被宣传到了天上去了呢！
content_en:
"You didn't come home all night, why don't you consider your family's feelings?"
Su Bai scolded with a straight face.
"I..." Xiao Lingxi lowered her head and muttered: "Have they ever considered my feelings?"
"You, you, you!" Su Bai was helpless.
Xiao Lingxi is not his child, and he has no right to interfere too much.
If his child is so naughty, he promises to bring out the seven wolves to give him a perfect childhood!
"Ding, the host's cultivation has reached a breakthrough!"
Suddenly, the system's voice sounded in Su Bai's mind.
【Host】
Name: Su Bai
Age: 18
Realm: Third level of Qi refining
Item: 20 coins
"Third level of Qi refining?"
Su Bai couldn't help but look at Zhuge Feng, who was still practicing.
As the leader of the Tiandao Sect, his cultivation level is ten times that of all the disciples of the sect combined.
But now, the Tiandao Sect has only one disciple, Zhuge Feng!
His cultivation is equivalent to being bound to Zhuge Feng.
In other words, if he breaks through, then...
"Ding, the disciple has achieved a breakthrough in cultivation, and will be rewarded with 10 sect points."
"Bang!"
A crisp sound rang out from Zhuge Feng's body, and then, the airflow around him suddenly increased several times, and a powerful momentum burst out.
Swish——
He opened his eyes, his eyes were shining brightly and he was full of energy.
Qi refining level one!
"Huh..." Zhuge Feng exhaled a breath of turbid air, slowly clenched his fist, a crackling sound came out, and a faint green light appeared on the fist.
"Is this the power those immortals have?"
He usually takes time to exercise. In addition, his job as a handyman is often heavy and tiring, and he can lift hundreds of kilograms of heavy objects with both hands.
But at this moment, after the spiritual energy broke through the acupoint, the whole body was strengthened by the spiritual energy and filled with endless power.
At this moment, Zhuge Feng felt that he had endless energy all over his body.
"With my current strength, I should be able to avenge my parents, right?" Zhuge Feng clenched his fists, his eyes filled with blood.
"Refining one level of Qi in one night?"
Xiao Lingxi was dumbfounded. From the time she met Su Bai until now, she had been shocked so many times in just one day.
Even if Tiandao Sect's immortal magic is so powerful, it won't be enough to refine Qi overnight, right?
You know, Ling Xiao, the first genius of the Lingxiao Sect, has been promoted to the sky for half a month of Qi refining level one!
